configurations.O: Pinned pre-CQRS source with its original schema and required components
configurations.A: Pinned AB_list V1, authoritative reader; producer/projector enabled, shadow disabled
configurations.B: Identical AB_list V1 build and maintenance; projected reader, unbilled authoritative control

pcn.fixture: phase1-pcn-shape-v1: 100 owners/pets and one appointment, medical, hotel, invoice and notification per owner

acceptance.freshnessAndRecoveryReference: phase2-plan/cqrs/acceptance.json: V1 freshness p95 2000ms/p99 5000ms, 3x1000 mutations; recovery 3x60s, catch-up <=120s; other correctness/fallback/rebuild gates unchanged
acceptance.wholeFeatureRegressionGrading: Every valid matched pair and workload separately; insufficient appointment write samples are inconclusive, not rescued by rescue-write counts.

excludes: new freshness/recovery/rebuild drills if existing evidence does not match the build/profile
listStudy.scope: Demonstrates the pinned V1 CQRS revision only; no V2 or future integrated-product recommendation

historicalBridge.operationWeights: Same eight logical tasks and weights as the list-study PCN; a new bridge protocol, not original PCN acceptance
historicalBridge.canonicalFixture: phase1-pcn-shape-v1 logical rows, mapped to each source schema; authentication through each real public login/gateway
historicalBridge.collectionContract: Complete owner-scoped logical collection; paginate to completion when needed; all HTTP calls/bytes/time included in one business-operation latency. No truncation of an old unpaged response to fake a cheap first page.
historicalBridge.asyncWriteContract: Record accepted HTTP and terminal persisted business completion separately. Completion observer cost is accounted for. Non-equivalent completion or missing task blocks matched grading.
historicalBridge.normalization: Only wiring, equivalent representation and nondeterministic transport metadata; no business logic/auth bypass/caching or task/weight changes
historicalBridge.denominator: Successful completed business operations, with physical HTTP request counts also reported; never compare this rate to old aggregate HTTP RPS
historicalBridge.interpretation: Whole-revision comparison with module split/index/request/auth changes disclosed; not causal proof of the module split alone

generatorValidity.calibrationTarget: Local no-op/loopback outside application, with the planned concurrency, observer and resource collector running; never lower application arrival rate from calibration
generatorValidity.openLoopLatency: Both completion minus dispatch and completion minus scheduled; use scheduled end-to-end latency for acceptance, retain all failures/drops in outcome counts
generatorValidity.closedLoop: 100 active users throughout measured window, no ramp/warmup samples, raw per-user task/wait/start/completion, event-loop delay probe at 10Hz with the same 100ms p99/1000ms maximum; actual RPS is an outcome
generatorValidity.invalidRule: Do not grade latency/throughput from invalid scheduling, missing timestamps or population; preserve raw and report INVALID_ENVIRONMENT or INCONCLUSIVE

sessions.unit: One complete matched block in one notebook kernel; multiple blocks allowed if profile remains identical
sessions.replacementRule: Only objectively incomplete/invalid-environment blocks, never a valid slow/losing block; retain original and replacement, first valid complete block wins. A second environmental invalidity stops the study as incomplete. Correctness/application failures halt for diagnosis, not replacement.
sessions.profileMismatchRule: Keep separate strata; complete all three blocks under one comparable key for an acceptance. Never combine unmatched halves or choose a winning session.
sessions.accounting: All API/worker/PG-child/broker/Redis/gateway/audit CPU in measured window; generator/controller separately, root cgroup total separately; uncovered/unreadable process CPU means TOTAL_COST_INCONCLUSIVE
sessions.protectedData: Disposable owned trial DB/schema/marker/roles/queues only, correct schema per source. Never use main DB, mix V1/V2 consumers or run V1 binary on V2.
